title: Урок 21: Проект среднего уровня — «Task Manager» (Full-Stack Like)

items: Построить SPA с роутингом, состоянием, API-слоем
Применить: модули, классы, асинхронность, паттерны, тесты, линтинг
**Авторизация**: Регистрация, вход, JWT в HttpOnly cookie, защищённые роуты
**Офлайн**: Service Worker, IndexedDB кэш, синхронизация при онлайне
**API**: Fetch wrapper с interceptors, retry, токены
**Тесты**: Vitest + Testing Library + MSW (Mock Service Worker)

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  NODE_VERSION: '20'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint

  typecheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run test -- --run --coverage
      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [lint, typecheck, test]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/

  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'npm'
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
      - run: npx serve -s dist -l 3000 &
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      - run: npm run test:e2e

  deploy-preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build, e2e]
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist
          path: dist/
      - name: Deploy to Netlify/Vercel preview
        run: npx netlify deploy --dir=dist --message="PR #${{ github.event.number }}" || npx vercel --token=${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
